questions.question: A is father of B, but B is not his son. D is wife of A. C is son of D. How is D related to B?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76ea95209e359b45c5360d6f580b14e7c2ab9851df6392c4699809e3f2c61e6d.png] 

According to the given conditions, the following figure is obtained :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01ddcd0a6a580e5d6ac737079561f781b535bbb42d010c4a3b8654110a8e25e8.png]

questions.question: Niranjan is the son of Sumit. Prakriti is the mother of Nilanjana. Virat's mother is Nilanjana. Prakriti is the mother of Kriti's father, Niranjan. How is Sumit related to Prakriti?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac0c6517c78366a4afbdf5f5d4719f53e4d50d2926f57fabb27d0c557a1c0140.png] 

From the given information,

1) Niranjan is the son of Sumit.

2) Prakriti is the mother of Nilanjana. Virat's mother is Nilanjana.( Implies Prakriti is the maternal grandmother of Virat.)

3) Prakriti is the mother of Kriti's father, Niranjan.( Implies Kriti is the daughter of Niranjan and Niranjan is the son of Prakriti. Hence, Prakriti is the paternal grandmother of Kriti. )

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/243d5090fb81c7073d5fb13f5cc27aafc9ca52d8e63dc13ea053e98bcac63eba.png] 

Thus, **Sumit is the husband of Prakriti.**

 **__ALTERNATE SOLUTION:__** 'Time- efficient'

To determine: Sumit's relation to Prakriti.

Therefore, solve only that part of the given question that involves the relation between Sumit and Prakriti.

1) Niranjan is the son of Sumit.

2) Prakriti is the mother of Kriti's father, Niranjan.(Implies Kriti is the daughter of Niranjan and Niranjan is the son of Prakriti. Hence, Prakriti is the paternal grandmother of Kriti.)

From this information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be53a42332aa86345b0a5c74c0460894b8f90ba52b11ff5a14a26163800ca467.png] 

Thus, **Sumit is the husband of Prakriti.**

questions.question: Malti is the daughter of the father-in-law of Vivek's wife. Arpit is the grandson of Neetu, who is the wife of Dayal. Vivek is the only son of Dayal. Sushmita is the sister of Malti. How is Vivek's wife related to Arpit?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

So, according to the question :

1) Vivek is the only son of Dayal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/733e911635a48626d143cb9644e2f174cc2438275e6e4ef4f24463373c18c4b9.png] 

2) Malti is the daughter of the father-in-law of Vivek's wife.

There are two possible cases i.e either Dayal is the father-in-law of Vivek's wife or Dayal is the mother-in-law of Vivek's wife.

 
• Case - (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef7cf94389730f797fbed03d80869568b18cd658b83314fe5be1884d997a7111.png] ​

 
• Case - (2)

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/250cfc5f30717600ccac5fadba30d9b68e3b15aa06666ee42ab414a5ece49a73.png] 

3) Sushmita is the sister of Malti. 

 
• Case - (1)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db32f1ab51c1bae87198a84e8344ceafaecfb1c2e026df56d858dbd00b1e3fa0.png] 

 
• Case - (2)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15e0f318f85a92728f5d217291c8257af84fef54d92737e48c88e4d2ae8e3e97.png] 

4) Arpit is the grandson of Neetu, who is the wife of Dayal.

Arpit is the son of Vivek as no other children of Dayal and Neetu are married yet.

Also Neetu is the mother-in-law and Dayal is the father-in-law of Vivek's wife. Therefore case - (2) is eliminated.

 
• Case - (1)

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4efc7a9c1c11b786491f212d77eeb79e6fff6242a56b8fc24a4eec0df08158d.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree Vivek's wife is the mother of Arpit.
